game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Geyser Flats, erupting geyser flats: the lava scout must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the lava scout's power beats the shield shown by fire sprites.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Geyser Flats: erupting geyser flats
core_gameplay_loop: In Geyser Flats, repeat each round: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the lava scout's power beats the shield shown by fire sprites. Each round, fire sprites strike the forge anvil, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the power value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the forge anvil from fire sprites in Geyser Flats: keep the power meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 33-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: power drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 33-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 2 (intro tier): Comparison Duel
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Geyser Flats.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 33 seconds while power > 0.
